data.title: Meridian opens a smart manufacturing lab in Rayong
data.excerpt: The demonstration lab connects a small production cell, quality inspection, and an operating data model in one testable environment.
data.body:
Meridian has opened a smart manufacturing lab at its Rayong engineering centre. The lab is a demonstration and testing environment for automation, traceability, and operating-data projects.

The facility includes a compact production cell, in-line inspection, and a data platform that mirrors the architecture used in client projects. It is intended for factory acceptance testing, operator workshops, and integration rehearsals before work begins on a live line.

This is illustrative portfolio content for the fictional Meridian brand. No real facility, certification, or client engagement is claimed.
